title: Development Approach and Life Cycle Performance Domain
coreMove: Choose predictive, adaptive, or hybrid work by fit: match uncertainty, cadence, governance, and feedback needs, then keep checking whether the lifecycle still helps value flow.

exampleSpecs.stakes: visible delay may hide lifecycle damage across the project system
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: one lived detail shows the Development Approach and Life Cycle Performance Domain inside the PMBOK Guide map of 8 domains

exampleSpecs.audience: teams reviewing delivery failure after release
exampleSpecs.stakes: postmortem must locate the decisive lifecycle misfit behind rework
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the failure is already visible, and the trace points to predictive control used where adaptive feedback was needed

exampleSpecs.audience: product owners choosing an approach under mixed uncertainty
exampleSpecs.stakes: one method label may flatten different parts of the work
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist notices her own lifecycle-label error midstream and corrects the frame

exampleSpecs.audience: project sponsors asking for lifecycle rationale
exampleSpecs.stakes: the artifact must justify approach by signals rather than method preference
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: a written memo carries the scene and weighs predictive, adaptive, hybrid, and cadence signals

exampleSpecs.stakes: same project request produces different outcomes under copied method versus fit-based design
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: two people face the same situation with opposite approaches and equal weight

exampleSpecs.audience: project managers stuck on method identity
exampleSpecs.stakes: a peer conversation reframes lifecycle as a whole-system performance setting
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the coach gives a quotable reframe tied to the PMBOK Guide map of 8 domains
